name: Lipstick Adventure 3
original_name: リップスティックアドベンチャー３
source:
This entry in the Lipstick Adventure series continues the story of the young private detective Gorou and his sweetheart Otomi. After attending a friend's marriage ceremony, they return to Gorou's office and find a strange package in the flowers. The package contains pictures of Otomi and several other girls, her schoolmates, some of them naked. Gorou heads to Otomi's high school to begin the investigation, without realizing that he will soon become involved in a sinister conspiracy...

Like the previous games in the series, "Lipstick Adventure 3" walks a fine line between adult and non-adult games, having graphical nudity and plenty of sexual innuendo, but no explicit sex scenes.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/lipstick-adventure-3]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
本作延续了《Lipstick Adventure》系列中年轻私家侦探五郎与恋人音美的故事。参加完朋友的婚礼后，两人回到五郎的事务所，却在花束中发现了一个奇怪的包裹。里面装着音美和几名同校女生的照片，其中有些人甚至一丝不挂。五郎前往音美就读的高中展开调查，却没有意识到自己很快便会卷入一场险恶的阴谋……

与系列前作一样，《Lipstick Adventure 3》游走在成人游戏与非成人游戏的边缘：作品中既有直观的裸露画面，也充斥着性暗示，但没有露骨的性爱场景。

[引自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/lipstick-adventure-3]Moby Games[/url]]
